submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2.5 mm gap is recommended as the only viable option that meets the laboratory's environmental policy (GWP ≤ 150). While this configuration achieves a time resolution of 1.95 ns, which falls short of the 1.5 ns requirement by 0.45 ns, it represents the best performance possible within environmental constraints. Mixtures G1 and G3, though achieving excellent time resolutions of 0.9 ns and 1.3 ns respectively, violate the GWP constraint and are therefore not permissible. The 2.5 mm gap provides the best time resolution for Mixture-G2 across the tested range. This recommendation prioritizes compliance with the hard environmental constraint while achieving the best available performance. Project stakeholders should evaluate whether the 1.95 ns time resolution is acceptable for the detector upgrade or if mixture development is needed to meet both constraints simultaneously.
